title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Goal: focused 30m with Eng lead - unblock perf work, align on Dedicated capacity commit, surface Private deployment asks.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights (2-3 min)
  - Prod latency p50 stable, p95 bumped last week after release (see ENG-4821).
  - Positive: streaming reliability improved on hosted API for short sessions.

- API (10 min)
  - Perf regression triage: collect traces + top callers (priority). Action: ask infra to instrument per-model sequence-length distribution (Omar).
  - Rate limiting / quotas: customer feedback that soft-limits are confusing - consider clearer 429 error + link to quota page.
  - Streaming anomalies: occasional stalled chunks for >500ms; hypothesis: batching delay + connection handling. Need owner for experiments.

- Console & Rollouts (6 min)
  - Model pinning UX: PM ask for a simpler dropdown + quick canary toggle. Prototype next week.
  - Dashboard telemetry: add token-level cost breakdown for per-route view (requested by a pilot customer).
  - Rollouts: want ability to schedule rollback after canary if errors > threshold.

- Dedicated capacity (6 min)
  - Capacity commit plan: confirm next quarter reserved sizes vs expected usage. Need SLOs + burst policy finalized to price.
  - Autoscale policy: defaults are aggressive - propose new defaults to reduce cost for small teams.

- Private deployments / On-prem (6 min)
  - Packaging: customers ask for a lightweight kube manifest + helm chart for air-gapped installs.
  - KMS/HSM integration: timeline? legal needs for EU pilot (Priya coordinating).
  - Audit logs + retention: default 90 days but enterprise asks for 1 year.

Notes / talking points:
- Prioritize work that reduces per-token unit cost vs marginal UX improvements. Need your input on order.
- For perf work: schedule a 2-week deep-dive with serving-runtime + infra to run targeted benchmarks (requesting 1 GPU for repro).
- Risk tolerance: are we okay shipping a canary with degraded throughput for short window (to validate correctness) if we can auto-fallback?

Action items (post-1:1):
- Lena: draft ticket prioritization doc for API perf v. console UX (due EOD Fri).
- Omar: add model seq-length hist to tracing and flag top 10 callers (ENG-4978) - start this week.
- Kai: prototype model-pin UI flows and share mock on Tuesday.
- Eng lead: confirm Dedicated capacity numbers for Q1 by 2025-01-30.
- Lena + Priya: sync with compliance on KMS timeline and share gaps.

Follow-ups to ask in meeting:
- Can we get dedicated infra support for the 2-week perf spike? (owner + effort estimate)
- Which console features can be deprioritized if we need to reallocate engineers to perf?
- Any upcoming hiring that helps cover Dedicated/Private support (SWE or SRE)?

Misc notes / reminders to self:
- Bring up customer X feedback re: confusing quota page (copy Slack thread link in follow-up).
- Prepare quick demo of canary rollback UI if time allows (3 min).
- Keep the convo time-boxed - flag anything deep for follow-up convo with smaller group.
